Group rides in Idaho

6 recurring group rides around Idaho: 5 road, 1 mountain bike. 5 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Tuesday Night Easy Ride in Pocatello — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Lactic Acid Cycling Saturday Ride runs a group 18–22 mph, B group 16–18 mph.
